title: Week 6 — Subject-matter jurisdiction and diversity
summary: Lacks, Article III, Strawbridge, § 1332, Mas v. Perry, and A.F.A. Tours. Read the statutes identified in the chapter, especially §§ 1331, 1332, 1367, and 1441. Subject-matter jurisdiction recurs later in the course.
